timeline.summary: NTPC commissioned 90 MW of solar capacity at the Khavda-II project in Gujarat, bringing group installed capacity to 89,705 MW.
NTPC commissioned 100 MW of solar capacity at Ramagundam, taking group installed capacity to 89,805 MW.
On 7th May 2026, NTPC agreed to acquire MCD's 26% stake in NTPC EDMC Waste Solutions Private Limited for ₹0.052 Cr to make it a wholly owned subsidiary.
On 15 May 2026, NTPC announced the commercial operation of 62.5 MW of solar capacity across step-down subsidiaries, taking total installed capacity to 89,868 MW.
NTPC commissioned Unit-2 (800 MW) of Patratu Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Limited, taking group capacity to 90,668 MW.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹49,687.77 Cr (-0.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹10,486.47 Cr (+37.8% YoY).

NTPC held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on 23 May 2026, outlining capacity addition plans and NGEL capex.
NTPC group total installed capacity reached 90,773 MW on 28 May 2026 after commissioning the final 105 MW part of the Khavda-II Solar PV Project.
NTPC received ₹5.31 lakh fines each from BSE and NSE for non-compliance with Regulation 17(1) board composition rules for Q4FY26.
NTPC commissioned the 34.4 MW second part of the Ramagundam Solar PV Project, taking total group installed capacity to 90,807 MW.
NTPC signed SJVA-III with UPRVUNL on 4 June 2026 to expand Meja Stage-II JV capacity from 2x660 MW to 3x800 MW.
THDC India Limited commissioned an 11 MWac floating solar plant on the Raw Water Reservoir of Khurja STPP with commercial operation from 17 July 2026.
NTPC Green Energy commissioned 64.76 MW solar capacity at Khavda, Gujarat on 24 July 2026
NTPC reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹50,741 Cr and PAT of ₹6,896 Cr
